text: FUCK! A bird keeps shitting on me while I'm walking.
And it's starting to piss me the fuck off. This motherfucker.
So I go inside my house. But it's in my house now. Still. Fucking. Shitting on me.
He doesn't give a flying fuck.
My wife is screaming at me... mostly because I haven't made love to her in three months. But I'm covered head to toe in bird shit! I don't give a fuck.
So I dig an underground bunker. Try to get in here, motherfucker.
The bird finds me... and shits directly into my mouth.
So I sneak laxatives in his food. That'll teach that bastard a lesson.
But wait... it's about to fucking explode. It's holding... and holding...
BOOM! Bird shit all over me. I look like a fucking porta potty.
The ass blast sends the bird all the way to my wife... and now he's shitting on HER.
He isn't shitting on me anymore, so that's great. Sweet!
